highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Established in 1855, William Paterson University is a public university located in Wayne, New Jersey. It is recognised for its academic excellence and is ranked 60th among the regional universities in the North by U.S. News & World Report in 2025.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: William Paterson University boasts a vibrant community with over 100 student clubs and organisations. You can engage in several academic, social, and cultural clubs. The University also actively commits to inclusion and diversity through various initiatives, including cultural awareness events and inclusive policies.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University provides multiple on-campus housing options, including traditional residence halls and apartment-style living. You can choose from their 6 residence halls and several apartments close to the campus.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The David and Lorraine Cheng Library at the campus features extensive resources including books, journals, and digital media. The library also has collaborative study spaces to enhance your study experience.

Sports
The University has many modern athletic facilities, such as a fitness centre, outdoor fields, and gymnasiums. The University competes in NCAA Division III sports as the Pioneers, in basketball, soccer, and swimming.

Laboratory
The University’s Science Complex has several state-of-the-art research and teaching labs for biology, chemistry, and environmental science. Some key facilities include the Human Performance Lab, Biomechanics Lab, Motor Control Lab, and the Data Science Research Lab.

Cafeteria
You’ll have a wide range of dining options at William Paterson University. There are several eateries on campus offering meal plans. The University’s main dining hall – the Wayne Dining Hall – offers you several cuisines and food options, including international ones.
